name: Snow Rain
source:
For the first time in decades, Isaki Haruki is visiting the snowy city where he spent his childhood.

Walking the streets with his childhood friend Suzu, he meets a girl named Yuki.

"What's your name?"
"My name? Haruki. Isaki Haruki."
"Haruki-kun?"

The stopped clock begins to move.

Warm tears melt the cold snow.

[translated from [url=http://stylezero.yukishigure.com/snowrain/sora/story.html]official site[/url]]
